overview: PowerAmp Player is a premium dark-themed music player with a fully programmed Virtual Amp system, Digital Stimulation + Analog Tube combined amps, Bluetooth analyzer with live power tracking, SRS/XM audio processing, and automatic 1-300 Hz frequency output across all channels.
features: Music player with visualizer, album art, queue management
Animated power chain startup sequence (Batteries → Fuses → Amp → Features → Settings)
Virtual Amp with 6 screens inside a file drawer (Pioneer GM-DX104 style)
SMD AMM-1 live ohms/watts diagnostic meter
Digital Stimulation + Analog Tube combined amps (real-world PWM and tube specs)
4-channel power split: Bass 6000W / Mids 3000W / Highs 2000W / Tweeters 1000W
Protection system: Stabilizer 50M×86 + Commander Direct Hit
SRS HRTF processing — 30-foot surround effect in all directions
XM frequency bypass and banding — 24dB/octave, THD <0.01%, SNR >110dB
Automatic 1-300 Hz frequency output on all channels
Bluetooth analyzer with persistent speaker profiles and live 12,000W power budget
